description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectLungNodule operation for chest CT lung nodule detection
description_zh: 本文介绍胸部CT肺结节检测DetectLungNodule的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess detect-lung-nodule --data-format DICOM --org-name weiyi --org-id 0001 --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/000001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectLungNodule

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

fields.help_en:
The URL of the DICOM image. The URL must be less than 600 characters in length. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1&URLList.2.URL=url2&..., where url1 and url2 are actual URLs. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList
fields.help_zh:
DICOM影像的图像URL地址。长度小于600。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The nodule threshold. Default value: 0.60. Value range: `(0,1]`. A lower value returns more nodules. Only two decimal places are retained
parameters.help_zh: 结点阈值。默认取值0.60，取值范围`(0,1]`，取值越低，输出结节越多，仅取小数点后两位
parameters.name: threshold

Data.description_en:
The returned data.
After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Series.description_en: The per-sequence results of this image analysis. Only a single sequence is supported, so the length of this JSON array is 1. Each array element is the detection result of a single sequence, consisting of analysisResult and seriesInstanceUid
Series.description_zh: 本次影像分析的分序列的结果，只支持单序列，故该jsonArray的长度为1。数组元素为单个序列的检测结果，由analysisResult和seriesInstanceUid构成

Category.description_en:
The nodule classification. Valid values:

0: ggo (ground-glass opacity)
1: part-solid (partially solid)
2: solid
3: unknown
4: calc (calcification)
Category.description_zh:
结节分类，取值包括：

0：ggo（磨玻璃影）
1：part-solid（部分实性）
2：solid（实性）
3：unknown（未知）
4：calc（钙化）

Confidence.description_en: The confidence level of the nodule classification

ImageX.description_en: The x-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the image coordinate system
ImageX.description_zh: 结节在图像坐标系中的x轴坐标值

ImageY.description_en: The y-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the image coordinate system
ImageY.description_zh: 结节在图像坐标系中的y轴坐标值

ImageZ.description_en: The z-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the image coordinate system
ImageZ.description_zh: 结节在图像坐标系中的z轴坐标值

Lobe.description_en: The lung lobe segment. Valid values: up (upper lobe), middle (middle lobe), down (lower lobe), and unknown
Lobe.description_zh: 肺叶分段。取值包括：up（上叶）、middle（中叶）、down（下叶）及unknown（未知）

Lung.description_en: The location of the nodule in the lung. Valid values: left (left lung), right (right lung), and unknown
Lung.description_zh: 结节在肺叶的位置。取值包括：left（左肺）、right（右肺）及unknown（未知）

items.description_en: A quintuple of [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, len], where start and end are the start and end points of the major axis in the image coordinate system, and len is the length of the major axis in mm
items.description_zh: [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, len]五元组，其中start和end为图像坐标系下长径的起止点，len为长径长度（mm）

MeanValue.description_en: The mean CT value, in Hounsfield units (HU)

items.description_en: A quintuple of [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, len], where start and end are the start and end points of the minor axis in the image coordinate system, and len is the length of the minor axis in mm
items.description_zh: [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, len]五元组，其中start和end为图像坐标系下短径的起止点，len为长径长度（mm）

RecistSOPInstanceUID.description_en: The ID of the frame where the maximum diameter of the nodule is located
RecistSOPInstanceUID.description_zh: 结节最大径位置所在帧的ID标识

Risk.description_en: The confidence level that the nodule is malignant. Value range: 0 to 1
Risk.description_zh: 结节为恶性的置信度。取值范围0~1

SOPInstanceUID.description_en: The ID of the frame where the nodule center is located
SOPInstanceUID.description_zh: 结节中心位置所在帧的ID标识

X.description_en: The x-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the physical coordinate system
X.description_zh: 结节在物理坐标系中的x轴坐标值

Y.description_en: The y-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the physical coordinate system
Y.description_zh: 结节在物理坐标系中的y轴坐标值

Z.description_en: The z-axis coordinate value of the nodule in the physical coordinate system
Z.description_zh: 结节在物理坐标系中的z轴坐标值

items.description_en: The position of the image coordinate system origin in the physical coordinate system
items.description_zh: 图像坐标系原点在物理坐标系中的位置

Report.description_en: The reference report generated by the AI service after analyzing the DICOM sequence
Report.description_zh: 该DICOM序列经过AI分析后AI服务给出的参考报告
Report.example: 肺部见1个实性结节，直径约为25.60mm，体积为11512.06mm³，平均CT值为-6.90HU。

SeriesInstanceUid.description_en: The series instance UID of the analyzed image

items.description_en: The actual distance interval per pixel
items.description_zh: 每个像素的实际距离间隔

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
